notes:
New Pix4Dfields-style workflow:
- Opens straight onto the map. Import a folder or individual photos and the project is created and named after the folder; click the name at the top to rename it.
- Import details list photos that will be skipped (no GPS, tilted, other camera) and ignore thumbnails and old project folders.
- Open an existing GeoTIFF to split and export it without processing.
- Processing options window: Fast / Balanced / Accurate plus a resolution slider, with the area, file size and processing time shown before you start. Time estimates learn this PC's speed after each job.
- Status bar along the bottom with progress, time left and Stop processing; the progress bar now moves in step with real time.
- Separate Export window: whole orthomosaic and/or areas, Compact or Lossless, 100 / 50 / 25 % resolution, overviews on or off, with the size shown up front.
- Projects page with previews (grid button at top left).
